sentences.text: The defect was fixed in a hotfix released 2026-03-19, which is listed in the v3.3.2 section of the release notes, and it was a hotfix for the dispatch outage described in INC-20260314-07.
The defect was a connection pool leak in the dispatch service, introduced in v3.3.1.
Connections that timed out while a robot was switching access points were not returned to the pool, so the pool slowly shrank.
The hotfix changed the service so that connections that time out while a robot switches access points are returned to the pool.
